# Complete Statistical Audit

This appendix is generated from the adjacent machine-readable JSON. No table performs a second statistical calculation.

## Audit conventions

- Difference: `comparator_minus_reference; positive means DD-Mamba is better`.
- Primary inference: paired two-sided Student t test with a 95% t interval.
- Small-n sensitivity: exact two-sided sign-flip enumeration; its minimum attainable p-value is shown without asymptotic substitution.
- Multiplicity: BH q-values are reported for both the predeclared displayed family and the full observed family.
- Legacy provenance: a `pair_index` is an anonymous positional pairing key, not a seed ID.

## Audit conventions

- Difference: `comparator_minus_full; positive means removing/replacing the component hurts`.
- Paired two-sided t tests and 95% t intervals are primary; exact sign-flip tests are small-n sensitivity analyses.
- BH correction is performed independently for the branch-removal and component-placement families.
- Legacy pair indices remain anonymous and are not seed IDs.

## Family registry

| Family ID | Size | Description |
|---|---:|---|
| `branch_removal.all` | 54 | All frequency- and time-branch removals across every observed dataset-horizon cell |
| `component_placement.all` | 29 | All placement, replacement, normalization, initialization, and fusion comparisons |
